annotations.title: Change the signed-in person's profile and settings

description: Changes only the fields sent: name (at most 40 characters, empty string clears it), locale (language tag of our e-mails, e.g. cs), country (one of the markets of get_my_profile, null clears it), watch_emails (false pauses every active price watch of the account and remembers which; true resumes exactly those, never a watch the person paused themselves). Needs the person's access token. Answers the profile with `changed` (and watches_paused / watches_resumed).

country.description: Market: an ISO country code from get_my_profile.markets.

locale.description: Language of our e-mails, e.g. cs, sk, en.

name.description: Shown with the person's reviews; at most 40 characters after trimming.

watch_emails.description: false = pause every price-watch e-mail; true = resume them.

name: update_my_profile
